name: hud_ui_composite_panel_vector_insert_copies
description: HudUiCompositePanelVector::InsertCopies behaves like the recovered MSVC vector insert helper for composite-panel entries, including reallocation, in-place long-tail insertion, and in-place short-tail insertion.
known_limits: Depends on HudUiCompositePanelEntry::ConstructorCopy and AssignCopy, which are functionally accepted but still carry inherited HudUiPanel copy/font-clone byte-shape drift.

VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?InsertCopies@HudUiCompositePanelVector@@QAEXPAUHudUiCompositePanelEntry@@IPBU2@@Z at 0x4bbff0 still fails: 740 unmasked mismatches, 48 relocation bytes masked, 0 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, Binary Ninja body is 814 bytes and the VC object symbol is 768 bytes. The drift begins at offset 0x2/original 0x4bbff2 and follows different vector-insert control-flow and scheduling shape.
tier_s_evidence: Binary Ninja shows three std::vector-style insert paths over 0x2c0-byte entries: allocate-and-copy when capacity is insufficient, in-place insertion when the old tail is at least the insertion count, and in-place insertion when the old tail is shorter than the insertion count.

The native vector-insert smoke validates final ordering, end/capacity cursors, transition-text ftable installation on constructed entries, and the old-entry destructor calls made by the reallocation path.
